snippet.title: 3 Tiny Sunnahs for Every Meal 🍽️ | Bismillah, Right Hand, Eat What's Near #shorts
snippet.description:
Three tiny rules that make every meal special! Our beloved Prophet Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) taught a young boy to say Bismillah, eat with his right hand, and eat from the food nearest to him.

Can your little one do all three at the next meal?

Sources
• Sahih al-Bukhari 5376: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:5376
• Sahih Muslim 2022: https://sunnah.com/muslim:2022

We never show any Prophet or Companion. All characters are faceless.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at

#IslamForKids #MuslimKids #Sunnah #shorts
